common.promptStandard: Purpose: authored support-surface tabletop and shelf clocks that reuse the verified host-driven analog or digital display geometry. Specification: preserve the wall clock display envelope and fixed display nodes while adding a bottom-centred support base, analog 0.35m x 0.35m x 0.08m or digital 0.50m x 0.18m x 0.06m. Units are metres, up is +Y, forward is +Z, and the installation origin is the bottom centre. Installation and load bearing: support-surface prop with mounting origin bottom, no scaling and no use points. Budget: reuse the pinned clock geometry with a real base, no textures, no animation, no external art, and the prior clock mesh/material/byte limits. State: host-driven time and existing clock settings, no new timer. Source/export: project-authored supported-clock parameters plus the pinned clock source/generator, GLTFExporter and GLTFLoader readback.
